mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate environment (FEDFUNDS < 4.0%) compresses discount rates and increases equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced cost of capital for corporate cash flows.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 4.0% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE > 5.0%) signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high consumer spending (RSAFS > 350000) and low industrial output (INDPRO < 115) indicates unsustainable demand-supply imbalance where consumption outstrips production capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days due to inventory drawdowns and margin pressure.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when RSAFS > 350000 and INDPRO < 115 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 5.0% and rising ≥0.5pp in prior quarter) increase real interest rates, reducing equity valuation multiples and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 5.0% and FEDFUNDS rise >= 0.5pp in prior quarter
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances during monetary tightening cycles as defined by the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained housing market expansion (HOUST > 1700.0) signals strong consumer confidence and construction sector growth, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when HOUST > 1700.0 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Robust employment growth (PAYEMS > 135000.0) indicates rising household income and consumption demand, boosting corporate revenue growth and producing positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS > 135000.0 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent GDP contraction (GDPC1 < 11400) and weak industrial production (INDPRO < 115) indicates broad economic slowdown, reducing corporate earnings forecasts and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when GDPC1 < 11400 and INDPRO < 115 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 200.0) trigger aggressive central bank tightening, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity risk premiums, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 200.0 over any 3-year rolling window.
